facts.value: Professora de Ensino Fundamental I, Years 1 to 5
Literacy tutor at Instituto Caminho Aberto, a small education charity in São Paulo
No formal reports. Runs training for the 14 class teachers at her school and for the technology link teacher at each of the 4 schools in her cluster.
R$ 5,480 a month gross on the municipal teaching scale, plus R$ 900 for the coordination post
Licenciatura em Pedagogia, Faculdade Santo Aurélio, São Paulo, 2019
No mathematics beyond secondary school. Finished a 40-hour online course in spreadsheets and basic statistics in July 2026, and has done the maths teaching for Years 4 and 5 for four years.
Has never held a budget, priced anything or read a commercial contract. The largest sum she has decided on is the R$ 3,200 the parents' council raised for a charging trolley.
Portuguese native, English working (free evening course at a state language centre, 2022 to 2024), Spanish reads but does not speak
Roughly 160 children have been in her own classes since 2021
Founded Roda de Sábado, a Saturday teachers' circle, in 2023; 140 teachers across 11 schools
Has never lived or worked outside Brazil. One week in Montevideo for a teachers' conference in 2024, self-funded.

segments.text: Run training for the 14 class teachers at my school and for the technology link teacher at each of the 4 schools in our cluster.
Introduced a daily 20-minute reading slot: the class average rose from 41 to 78 words a minute, and all 14 classes in the school adopted it.
Took 60 donated tablets out of the cupboard with 6 training sessions of 45 minutes; 9 of 14 teachers were using them by year end.
Founded Roda de Sábado, a Saturday teachers' circle, in 2023; it now brings together 140 teachers from 11 schools.
Professora Coordenadora de Tecnologia Educacional, Escola Municipal Professora Dalva Ribeiro, São Paulo (since February 2025). I teach half the week and cover technology for a cluster of 4 schools.
Roda de Sábado, a Saturday teachers' circle (founded 2023): 140 teachers from 11 schools share lesson sheets every other Saturday.

Before I taught, I was a literacy tutor at Instituto Caminho Aberto from March 2020 to January 2021. In February 2021 I took my own class at the school, and in February 2025 I became Professora Coordenadora de Tecnologia Educacional.

In the reading project the class average rose from 41 to 78 words a minute, and all 14 classes in the school adopted the daily slot. I now run training for the 14 class teachers and for the link teacher at each of the 4 schools in my cluster.
Beatriz became Professora Coordenadora de Tecnologia Educacional in February 2025, after four years as a class teacher at Escola Municipal Professora Dalva Ribeiro.
Please mention the tablets: 60 had sat in the cupboard for 7 months, and by year end 9 of the 14 teachers were using them.
